subject: Security review & onboarding — availability sweep
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@veridianhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@veridianhealth.com>, Sophie Bauer <sophie.bauer@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T09:15:00+02:00
Subject: Security review & evidence — onboarding timing

Hi Ben,

As we discussed last week, Veridian needs to schedule the formal security review as part of our onboarding. Stakeholders who need to attend: myself (security), Paul (infra/ops), and Sophie from procurement (contract lead). We also have one EU-based data residency reviewer who may join depending on the agenda.

Requirements to cover on the call:
- SOC 2 / relevant reports overview
- Data residency and retention controls (EU-specific)
- Network connectivity and integration model (KV cache / prefix caching impact)
- SLAs and support escalation path for Dedicated/Private options

We are preferred to have this the week of July 19 — mornings CET work best for our folks. Sophie needs at least a 10 business day lead for procurement if we discuss contract-level commitments.

Can you propose a few 45-min slots that include someone from Redwood security and an SE to walk through the architecture? Also please attach the SOC 2 executive summary and any short checklist so our procurement can pre-scan.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Security Operations
Veridian Health

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list.

We can absolutely run a 45-minute technical/security review that covers SOC2, data residency, and network/connectivity. I'm looping in Soojin (SE) and Mina (Security) — Mina will handle the compliance overview.

Proposed 45-minute slots (all CEST):
- Tue Jul 19 — 09:30–10:15
- Wed Jul 20 — 14:00–14:45
- Thu Jul 21 — 11:00–11:45

Notes:
- Mina is on PDT but has agreed to join mornings CET for customer reviews; she asked for the 14:00 CET option as first preference.
- We'll attach the SOC2 executive summary and a short prep checklist to this thread (see attachments).
- Before the customer-facing review, Soojin and I would like a 15-min internal prep call to align on architecture and any redline items — would your team be OK with us sending a separate internal invite?

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (executive), sec_review_prep_checklist.md (internal checklist)

If none of these work, tell us two windows that do and we'll adapt.

Best,

Hi Ben / team —

Thanks — Wed Jul 20 morning is best for us. Of the options above the 14:00–14:45 CET slot is perfect (Paul is GMT+1 as well, so that maps). Sophie from procurement has a policy: if contract terms are going to be discussed, she needs an invite at least 10 business days in advance — so please flag the meeting as "security review (no contract negotiation)" in the invite or include separate agenda bullet if you plan to touch licensing/price.

Two quick clarifications:
- Can you confirm whether the SOC2 summary contains the network segmentation appendix? We need to send that to our network team.
- Our data residency reviewer will join if the session includes retention and export controls. If you can call out a 10–15 minute segment for that, it'd be ideal.

Once you send a firm time we'll add Sophie to the invite (she only needs the high-level evidence; she won't attend all of it).

Regards,
Elena

Ben / Mina —

Quick internal note before I reply-all with the confirmed slot: can we do a 20-min internal sync on Wed Jul 20 at 12:15 CEST? I want to run through the architecture slide, clarify the data residency appendix location in the SOC2 pack, and confirm who will own the retention export answers.

I also added a very short prep checklist to the thread (sec_review_prep_checklist.md) — highlights:
- Owner for network segmentation questions (Mina)
- Owner for retention/exports (Soojin)
- Backup contact if Mina needs to drop (security@redwood.ai)

If that time conflicts for Mina say if 12:00 or 12:30 works. I'll keep it internal (no Veridian).

Thanks,

Hi all —

Confirmed: Wed Jul 20, 14:00–14:45 CEST for the security review. Agenda (45 min):
1) Introductions and scope (5 min)
2) SOC2 / compliance overview (Mina) (10 min)
3) Network & architecture walkthrough (Soojin) (15 min)
4) Data residency & retention (10 min)
5) Q&A and next steps (5 min)

Notes:
- Per Sophie’s ask, this invite is explicitly labeled "evidence & technical review — not contract negotiation" so procurement can attend without contract-level expectations.
- SOC2 executive summary contains the network appendix; Mina flagged the exact page range during our internal sync and I've uploaded a short extract to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Veridian/sec-evidence (see file "SOC2-extract-network.pdf").
- Internal prep: Soojin, Mina and I will do a 20-min sync Wed Jul 20 at 12:15 CEST. I'll send the internal invite separately.

I've created a calendar invite and added Sophie as "optional" so procurement can join the first 10 minutes. If anyone needs a different time, please say so within 24 hours and we'll pivot.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.
